sidebarHint: Empty threads stay hidden until you open them or send a message. Dashboard rows marked {{shared}} are older team chats (or API); new assistants are private by default.
visibilitySharedTitle: Shared dashboard chat — other members can read messages in this thread.
visibilityPersonalTitle: Personal dashboard chat — only you see this thread.
dashboardContextHint: (this dashboard id is passed to the agent; say "add milk" for this list)
sharedBannerBody: Other members who can access this dashboard may see messages you send here. Do not post secrets or private data.
personalBannerBody: Only your account sees this thread; it is not the shared team chat for this dashboard.
noActivityYet: No activity for this prompt yet.
composerAria: Message composer — drop files here or use the attach button
composerPlaceholder: How can I help you today?
attachTitle: Attach or drag & drop files (images, text; zip not unpacked)
agentLlmStreamTitleAgent: Agent mode only (WebSocket): stream LLM per round.
agentLlmStreamTitle: Stream LLM response per round when the provider supports it. Off = previous behavior.
agentLlmStreamHint: Enables agent_stream_llm. With tools: visible text until the tool call; more rounds follow.
replyModeTitle: Agent: tools + multi-round WebSocket. Chat: single streamed assistant message (HTTP).
replyModeChatHint: Chat mode sends agent_plain_completion so tokens stream when the model supports it.
switchToAgentModeHint: Switch to Agent mode to see tool and LLM activity per prompt.
emptyIntro: Agent mode: tools and activity in the header. Chat mode: streamed plain replies over HTTP (no tools).

generalAssistantHint: Ask for scans or repo work — General can delegate to specialist sub-agents.
showProjectTree: Show or hide project file tree
deleteProjectDescription: Permanently delete "{{name}}" and all files in its workspace folder. This cannot be undone.
deleteProjectSelfForbidden: The agentlayer-self workspace cannot be deleted here.
deleteProjectViewerForbidden: You only have read access to this project.
workspaceFromLinkNotFound: Project from the link was not found or you do not have access.

workspaceSwitchConfirmCancel: Cancel — change project in this thread anyway.
workspaceBoundHint: Workspace is now "{{name}}". For focused repo work, start a new chat with this project selected.
noProjectsAdmin: No projects yet. Add a workspace in Settings or ask your operator to provision one.
noProjectsUser: No projects assigned yet. Ask an admin to add a workspace for you.
titlesHint: Titles from the first message. Open a shared chat: URL query ?c=<id>. From Dashboards: ?dashboard=<uuid> sends agent_dashboard_context to the agent.
tasksBacklogHint: Backlog lives on the Tasks page, not here.
activityEmptyHint: Activity appears here when the agent runs tools or LLM rounds for the selected prompt.
